heading: 1. Topical Retinoids: The Gold Standard for Daily Care
alt: Retinoids increase cell turnover, stimulate new collagen, and block the enzymes that break existing collagen down

heading: 2. Neuromodulators: Relaxing the "Expression Lines."
alt: Neuromodulator injections take under 15 minutes, show change in 3 to 7 days, and last 3 to 4 months

heading: 3. Dermal Fillers: Restoring Lost Volume
alt: Three dermal filler types: hyaluronic acid, calcium hydroxylapatite for contouring, and poly-L-lactic acid

heading: Comparing the Top 3 Treatments
alt: Retinoids, neuromodulators and dermal fillers compared on what they suit, how they are applied, and how long they last

heading: How Do Chemical Peels Work?
alt: Light, medium and deep chemical peels compared by the skin layer reached, what each treats, and recovery time

heading: What Conditions Can a Chemical Peel Treat?
alt: Chemical peels treat sun damage and photoaging, acne scarring and texture, and hyperpigmentation including melasma

heading: Is a Chemical Peel Right for You?
alt: Wait on a chemical peel with an active infection or cold sore, in pregnancy, after isotretinoin, or with keloid scarring

heading: The Procedure: What to Expect
alt: Chemical peel timeline: stop retinoids beforehand, a 5 to 10 minute application, then flaking over 3 to 7 days

alt: A wellness assessment sets a health baseline, finds silent risks early, and looks at the whole person not one complaint

heading: The Core Pillars of a Holistic Wellness Assessment
alt: Wellness assessment pillars: clinical screenings and vitals, lifestyle and mental well-being, social determinants of health

heading: What to Expect During Your Visit
alt: A wellness assessment visit: the conversation about history and concerns, a head-to-toe exam, then a personalised plan

heading: Why Now? The Long-Term Benefits of Holistic Health
alt: Regular wellness assessments bring peace of mind, cost savings against chronic illness, and an ongoing health partnership

heading: Understanding the Basics: What is Functional Medicine?
alt: Functional medicine looks for root causes, treats the body as one integrated system, and aims at long-term resolution

heading: Functional Medicine vs. Conventional Medicine: What’s the Difference?
alt: Conventional medicine treats the leaves and leads on acute care; functional medicine tends the roots and suits chronic disease

heading: The Core Principles of the Functional Medicine Approach
alt: Functional medicine principles: patient-centered not disease-centered, longer appointments, and integrative evidence-based care

heading: What to Expect During a Functional Medicine Consultation
alt: A functional medicine consultation: a health history from birth, functional lab testing, then a personalised wellness plan
